answer: Verifiers post on-ledger stake and are slashed for countersigning any invalid transaction, with the penalty set several times above the total epoch reward. Faking one epoch of validation loses more than it earns, so each fake identity needs its own burnable bond, multiplying attacker costs across every sybil persona; random audits like wind shifting a dune keep bad signatures exposed, and one catch can incinerate the whole island-linked nebula of bonded identities at once.
